name: Flambeau River (North Fork)
blurb: The North Fork Flambeau River through Park Falls and the Flambeau River State Forest toward the Chippewa, with several dam portages.

timing.note: A reviewed speed/flow calibration has not been established. Access and guide information remain available.

sections.notes: Markers identify agency-listed access; the map states whether a landing or an approximate facility area has been reviewed. Mileage is preliminary, measured along USGS river geometry; it is not a surveyed paddling route. Difficulty has not been independently rated for every section. Check current conditions, hazards and access with the managing agency before paddling.

notices.title: River hazard
notices.text: WDNR Flambeau booklet (Hervas Camp Landing to Big Falls Dam): "About a mile below the last pitch of Cedar Rapids is Beaver Dam Rapids. This is a very dangerous drop and should be portaged on the left bank." The rapids are not pinned in this package.
notices.sourceName: WDNR — Flambeau River State Forest paddling guide (booklet PDF)

notices.text: WDNR Flambeau River State Forest booklet: "There is a portage of about 400 yards through Park Falls where the river runs through the paper mill's dam." WDNR lists two dam records here ('Upper Hydro' / 'Lower Hydro', 1.9 mi apart); the booklet describes one portage.

notices.title: Thornapple access and work notice
notices.text: Xcel’s September 28, 2026 notice says the east-side boat landing and tailwater access remain open during repairs. West-side fishing access is scheduled closed through November 6, 2026. The listed access is on the east side; check current signs and the operator’s updates. Stay away from the dam.
notices.sourceName: Xcel Energy — Thornapple Dam access notice
